proposition: Ibn Turka says he attacked two positions of messianic Sufis on his travels: the announcement that the Mahdi would come within two years and the Sufis rule the world, and the loosening of Sharīʿa duties.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Masdur II (ca. 832-35/1429-32, after exile)
mediation.note: written to the court that was judging him; MK: produced under duress, treat with caution (pdf p.32 fn 44)
